SpatialBoundingBox.description: 2D spatial bounding box in geographic coordinates.
SpatialBoundingBox.title: SpatialBoundingBox

description:
Contract for 2D curvilinear coordinate horizontal grids (ROMS, NEMO ORCA, HYCOM bipolar/tripolar).
Coordinates are 2D arrays: lon(eta, xi) and lat(eta, xi).

angle_variable_name.description: Variable name of the grid rotation angle field (radians between xi axis and true East).
angle_variable_name.title: Angle Variable Name

eta_dimension_name.description: Name of the along-grid meridional dimension (Y / eta).
eta_dimension_name.title: Eta Dimension Name

grid_id.description: Unique identifier for the curvilinear grid.
grid_id.title: Grid Id

has_curvilinear_metrics.description: Whether metric scale factors (pm, pn / dx, dy) are present in the dataset.
has_curvilinear_metrics.title: Has Curvilinear Metrics

pm_variable_name.description: Reciprocal of grid spacing in XI-direction (1/m).
pm_variable_name.title: Pm Variable Name

pn_variable_name.description: Reciprocal of grid spacing in ETA-direction (1/m).
pn_variable_name.title: Pn Variable Name

spatial_bounds.description: Geographic bounding box enclosing all valid cells.

xi_dimension_name.description: Name of the along-grid zonal dimension (X / xi).
xi_dimension_name.title: Xi Dimension Name

title: CurvilinearGridContract
